description.narrative: The project to support community resilience to the effects of climate change is designed to empower women and young people in the communes of Diffa, Chétimari and Maine Soroa who grow rice around the Komadougou Yobé. This project is intended as an appropriate response to the distress of these women and young people following the flooding caused by this year's torrential rains and the high water of the Komadougou, which damaged hundreds and hundreds of areas dedicated to this activity. The aim is to provide effective support to these victims, giving them confidence in the future of their traditional productive activity. Through this project, the womenand young people affected will not only be provided with quality inputs (vegetable seeds (rice, corn), fertilizers, fuel, farming equipment (hoe, dabas, wheelbarrow, rake), production equipment that they have lost - motor pumps, carts, macaroni processing machines and goat kits - but they will also benefit from close advisory support including a series of training sessions on various topics (cultivation techniques, small ruminant breeding) as well as taking climate change into account, preserving the environment (standards for fertilizer and pesticide use, the comparative advantages of organic manure and alternative techniques for combating insects harmful to crops, water resource management) and calculating the profitability of their activities. These recovery actions aim to mitigate the catastrophic effects of flooding on their households, to rebuild their means of production on a sustainable basis, and to adopt forward-looking practices with regard to flooding. The project operates in three (3) communes of the Diffa region, mainly the commune of Diffa, Chétimari and Maine Soroa, where for a number of years the NGO NCDR FADAMA has been working with these communities,which have paid a heavy price for the flooding phenomenon of this year 2024.In line with the guidelines of the call for proposals, the project's priorities are to better integrate women and young people at community level, take climate change into account, protect the environment and ensure household food security. The objectives of the project are to promote the access and effective participation of women and young people in community life,in order to boost their integration into the social fabric. In addition to material support, awareness-raising activities will also help to bring about positive changes in household behavior, particularly in terms of involving women and young people in decision-making concerning the management of household assets. The project covers three (3) communes: Diffa, Chétimari and Maine Soroa. PROJECT OBJECTIVESGeneral objective: Contribute to the resilience of women and young riceproducers affected by floods and cultural social contexts. Specific objectives:OS1: Strengthen the structural and organizational capacities of women and young rice producers to create a synergy of community action;OS2: Increase rice production and farm income of women and young producers by 10%.OS3: Strengthen the leadership and economic power of women and young people to empower them. EXPECTED RESULTSR 1: Groups of rice-growing producers' organizations are set up and operational in each commune,R 2: Rice production and farm income for women and young producers increased by 10%;R 3: The leadership and economic power of women and young people is strengthened.

participating-org.narrative: In order to promote the development of the population of Niger, especially in rural areas, the NGO Nouvelle Chance pour le Développement Rural, known as ONG NCDR - FADAMA, was created on August 15, 2011. It is an NGO under Nigerien law, recognized by theState of Niger by Arrêté N° 551/ DAPJ/ MI of August 15, 2011. The NGO has employees with a good knowledge of Niger's rural environment, as well as local communities and associations. The NGO NCDR-FADAMA, having noted an economic imbalance in its areas ofintervention to thedisadvantage of women, has focused its interventions on emergency actions and the socio-economic development of women and young people. The NGO NCDR-FADAMA is committed to supporting the most vulnerable populations in several sectors, including those covered by this call for expressions of interest.The NGO NCDR-FADAMA has 2 regional coordination offices, each with an executive office, in which it implements emergency/development projects. It has a national head office in Diffa run byanexecutive board. FADAMA's experience and skills give it operational capacity. The NGO NCDR-FADAMA is a member of the regional chamber of NGOs/development associations made up of several multi-sectoral networks. AREAS OF INTERVENTION The NGO NCDR-FADAMA has three (3) main areas of intervention: Food security (SECAL) with three (3) axes: resilience to climate change, concerted management of natural resources and support for agricultural and pastoral development. Governance and Democracy at local level withtwo (2) axes: Capacity-building for communal/local players, and Access to basic social services. Skills development and capitalization, with two (2) axes: monitoring, evaluation and capitalization. The vision of the NGO NCDR-FADAMA is to create an environment that can guarantee a minimum source of income for grassrootscommunities, enabling them to improve access to food and ensure a decent living environment in the community. The mission of the NGO FADAMA is to contribute to the improvement of incomes bysupporting actors in the improvement of living conditions of rural households through better access to basic social services.The values of the NGO NCDR-FADAMA can be summarized as follows: Solidarity - Honesty - Transparency. The main objectives oftheNGO NCDR-FADAMA are to- To contribute to the relief, assistance and progress of the most vulnerable populations in Niger:- Ensure the resilience of populations to climate change and support agricultural and pastoral development.- Strengthening good governance and democracy at local level;- Strengthen concerted management of natural resources;- Strengthen stakeholders' capacities.The NGO NCDR-FADAMA has developed strong expertise:- At community level, NCDR-FADAMA works closely with local organizations(youth and women and other rural producers) and local leaders to promote inclusive governance.- In relation tolaw, gender and women's empowerment: The promotion of human rights, particularly in defense of the rights of the most vulnerable - women, children and people with disabilities - is an integral part of NCDR-FADAMA's advocacy strategy. Key actions focus on the right to health, quality education, protection, food and responsible citizenship.- In terms of women's empowerment, actions focus on strengthening women's leadership, access to resources, active participation in civic life, economic empowerment and alleviation of domestic chores. - Protection and inclusion: Through its code of conduct, the NGO NCDR-FADAMA reinforces the professionalism of its staffin the respect of ethics and deontology to ensure the protection of the beneficiaries of its actions (partners or community members) against any misbehavior or abuse of power, while guaranteeing the respect of human dignity.Goal: To strengthen the participation of the underprivileged in the production system for sustainable development.
